Our Commitment

Every ELIEE event is designed for visionary entrepreneurs 40+ who are building with purpose and preparing for what’s next. These are spaces to gain insight, exchange ideas and leave equipped to move forward with clarity and confidence.

Still Called. Still Capable.
Still in the Game.

A business workshop for visionary women entrepreneurs 40+

10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
The Raleigh Room at The Farmhouse
Wendell Falls · Wendell, NC
At CapacityThis workshop is full. Join the waitlist to hear first about the next one.

You’re not starting late. You’re starting right now.

You’ve lived. You’ve led. You’ve loved. You may have even lost — but the vision is still there and the calling is still tugging. This intimate workshop is for women 40+ who are done playing small: seasoned starters, second-act visionaries and purpose-driven professionals ready to build with purpose rather than from overwhelm.

You’ll walk away with
  • A tangible business idea
  • A clear vision for your next move
  • A deep sense of alignment
  • A concrete, real-world strategy
  • Renewed confidence and clarity

We’re not chasing hustle. We’re building legacy.

Workshop Highlights

Clarity

Define the vision that’s still calling you.

Strategy

Map your next move with confidence.

Alignment

Build a business that honors your purpose.

Legacy

Lead with impact that outlives you.
